summary: Split the data plane from the management plane
description: SEC-01, SEC-02, and SEC-03. The data plane serves chat and a minimal health body. Every other path returns one generic 404. Responses do not advertise the server or the license.
scope: Health is status ok and carries no version
Unknown paths share one 404 body and hide framework headers
acceptanceCriteria: GET /health returns 200 and {"status": "ok"} with no version key. GET /license, GET /docs, and GET /no-such return the same status 404 and the same body, with code not_found. Headers have no server and no x-powered-by. The body does not contain license or version. SEC-01 SEC-02 SEC-03.
constraints: Do not serve OpenAPI, metrics, or license routes on the data plane.
Do not add a Server or X-Powered-By header.
Do not remove the existing create_gateway chat route.
workerGuidance: Small local model rule: solve only the active subtask. Do not implement later CTX tasks early.

After writing or changing a test, always call the declared pytest command before ending the turn. Do not stop with explanation text only.
If the active subtask's verification already passes because earlier work implemented it correctly, run the declared command and mark the subtask done. Do not rewrite unrelated files.
Keep edits inside targetArtifacts unless the subtask explicitly says otherwise.
When writing tests, assert only the current subtask's scope so later subtasks still have meaningful work.
